text:
zahra: Heads-up EU1->EU2 rollout seeing node join failures. GPUs fall back to older pools and we hit a cold-start cost spike. Looks like keystore Decrypt failing with "KMS NotFound" for an alias that exists in EU1 but not EU2.
tom: Hmm alias mismatch? We mirror keys per region but scripts recently changed to use alias/keystore-main vs alias/keystore-eu2. Any error logs?
zahra: From keystore sidecar on gpu-eu2-ctl-4:
```
2026-03-23T14:12:10Z ERROR keystore: NotFoundException: key alias/keystore-main not found in region eu-west-2 (attempted arn:aws:kms:eu-west-2:111:alias/keystore-main)
node: gpu-eu2-ctl-4
```
ben: Confirmed. The model-serving infra changed KMS usage to alias/keystore-main for central regions, but our regional key bootstrap only created alias/keystore-eu2. The endpoint policy and vpce checks are fine; it's purely alias/key name mismatch.
auditors: We have a live firewall/vpce tighten in EU that also denied cross-region KMS Lookups; combined with alias mismatch nodes fail fast.
ops-bot: alert: keystore.kms.notfound x 82 last 10m  https://ops/redwood/alerts/keystore-kms-notfound
oncall-sre: Mitigation options: 1) create alias/keystore-main in EU2 pointing to the regional key (fast, low risk), 2) revert infra change to use alias/keystore-eu2 (slower if needs release), 3) cross-region replication of key material (not possible for CMKs, need separate keys). Recommend option 1 for quick fix and follow up with canonical alias alignment in infra.
zahra: Agreed. Will create alias and add an explicit minimal endpoint policy Allow for keystore role if needed.
tom: CLI to add alias (example):
```
aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/keystore-main --target-key-id 1234abcd-5678-efgh-9999
```
ben: Also add a guard: VPCE policy shouldn't block DescribeKey/ListAliases for the keystore principal. Right now policy allows Decrypt but denies ListAliases in some tighter rules; that made debugging harder.
auditors: For audit/compliance, we must log alias creation and generate CloudTrail entry linking to the onboarding ticket. Keep alias creation TTL note in the change doc.
oncall-sre: Quick canary plan: create alias in eu-west-2, restart keystore sidecar on one canary node, verify Decrypt and kubelet secrets pull. If successful, roll to remaining pending nodes in that AZ.
ops-bot: deploy: keystore-alias-create requested by zahra  https://deploy/redwood/4456
zahra: Creating alias now and will post results.
zahra: Alias created alias/keystore-main -> keyid 1234abcd. Restarting keystore on gpu-eu2-ctl-4.
zahra: Canary succeeded: keystore.Decrypt OK, kubelet pulled secrets, node Ready.
ben: I'll patch VPCE policy to explicitly allow keystore principal ListAliases/DescribeKey to improve diagnostics, scoped only to the keystore prefix. Will also add a test in privatelink CI to ensure alias-listing works for keystore role.
tom: Follow-up: we should standardize on alias/keystore-main in infra repo and ensure regional bootstrap creates that alias on each regional key. Add a lint rule in bootstrap to fail if alias mismatch.
auditors: Cost note: fallback to old pools caused ~3h of burst traffic to warm standby in eu-west-1 -> eu-west-2 transfer & provisioning costs ~\u20ac290. We'll capture that in postmortem. Also need the CloudTrail entry for alias creation in the compliance log stream.
oncall-sre: Monitoring started 14:30. Current recovery: 15/17 pending nodes recovered after alias create + policy tweak. If any remain after 20m we'll evaluate rolling restarts.
zahra: I'll write the short postmortem and include the exact vpce policy snippet we used to allow DescribeKey/ListAliases for keystore. Also adding a task to the audit-hardening PR to avoid accidental denies that block diagnostic calls.
ben: Adding tests and a docs blurb about alias conventions.
ops-bot: alert updated: keystore.kms.notfound reduced, human close required  https://ops/redwood/alerts/keystore-kms-notfound
